programs.title: Find It, Fix It, Flog It
programs.desc: In Northern Ireland, Henry Cole and Gemma Longworth meet Dave, whose workshop is packed with treasure, including a church pew and a ladder that becomes a wardrobe.

programs.title: Help! We Bought a Village
programs.desc: Owners of a village in Limousin are in roof repair despair. Steve and Julie wrestle a water pipe at their cave village in Spain. The owner of an Italian borgo clinches a deal.

programs.title: Countdown
programs.desc: Colin Murray, Rachel Riley and Susie Dent host, with Lucy Porter in Dictionary Corner, as contestants race against the clock to pit their wits against vowels, consonants and numbers.

programs.title: A Place in the Sun
programs.desc: Mark's always loved Italy, and now that he's retired, he's set his sights on a holiday bolthole in Puglia. Can Laura Hamilton find Mark's perfect place for his £80k.

programs.title: Escape to Florida
